validation.how: The field label turns red; messages are listed in a Needs review section after Part II (first 20), and Queue for submission is disabled while any error exists.

Schedule 3 Items 5–6 — Non-taxable income and income subject to final tax

findings.now: The year box stays editable after the tile set it; Save draft under another year overwrites any saved Draft for that year, and a blank box is saved as year 0.
findings.why: The annual draft is keyed by TIN, form and the year as it stands after sync, so upsert_from_draft updates whichever row that year matches.

options.name: Read-only year from the tile
options.detail: Show the tile's year as text, so the key cannot change on this page.

options.name: Year choices limited to free years
options.detail: Offer only the tile's year or years with no saved Draft.

options.name: Guard the save
options.detail: Refuse Save draft and Queue when the year differs from the saved key or is blank.

findings.now: Twelve month buttons labelled 01 to 12 sit in one row, shown for a fiscal or short-period return.
findings.why: Twelve values form a list, and a combobox fits that better than a row of buttons.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: One combobox with 01 to 12 in place of the twelve buttons.

options.name: Read-only chip with popup
options.detail: Show the month as text and open the 01 to 12 list on click.

findings.now: The Schedule 1, Schedule 2 and Schedule 3 lists show fixed rows (6, 4 and 2) with no Add row, although the official popups accept more rows.
findings.why: The model accepts up to 100 popup rows (FORM_1702EX_MAX_ROWS), but the view draws only the fixed lines, so extra entries cannot be recorded.

options.name: Add-row list
options.detail: Let each popup-backed list grow with an Add row control, up to the model limit, matching the official OTHERS behaviour.

options.name: Combined extra line
options.detail: Keep the fixed lines and add one text and amount line that totals any extra items.

findings.now: Messages appear only in the Needs review section after Part II; the field label turns red, but no message sits beside the field.
findings.why: Errors are shown far from the input that caused them, so a user must scroll to read why Queue for submission is disabled.

options.name: Message under the field
options.detail: Show the message text beneath each input in addition to the red label.

options.name: Jump-to-error list
options.detail: Make each Needs review entry scroll to its field.

findings.now: When every check passes, no line says 'Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.'
findings.why: The official validate() shows this alert on success, and the page renders only the error list.

options.name: Success line in the review slot
options.detail: Show the verbatim success text where Needs review would be when there are no errors.

options.name: Status bar message
options.detail: Show the same text in the status message bar after a clean check.
